name: Airport board
summary: A split-flap departures board for a friend's early flight: flight, leave-by, pickup and airport are up and the ride row reads '????'; tap 'I'll drive' and the flaps clatter into your name, the status flips to confirmed, a little car sets off on the road to the plane, and a breakfast IOU gets stamped on the board.
useWhen: can anyone drive me to the airport thursday, 6:40am flight
need a ride to EFD friday morning pls
who can take me to the train station at 5
flight at 6 am, i'll buy you breakfast
airport run sunday? i land at 9pm
dontUseWhen: a group splitting into several cars (use carpool or event-carpool)
moving furniture with a car (use pickup-run)
booking or paying for a rideshare

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Ride to the airport'

flier.description: Who needs the ride (a name in the chat)

quote.description: What they asked, in their words

from.description: Pickup spot, up to 12 characters, e.g. '412 Pine'

to.description: Airport or station, up to 12 characters, e.g. 'EFD'

owes.description: What the flier owes the driver, stamped on the board, e.g. 'breakfast'; may be empty

driver.description: Who's already driving (a name in the chat), or empty
